title: Cross-border joint high net load warnings: research code and derived evaluation data
description: Research code and author-derived evaluation data accompanying Joint High Net Load Warnings and Review Allocation under Marginal Uncertainty in Europe, for synchronous high net load monitoring in Germany-Luxembourg, France and Belgium, with DK1/DK2 transfers. Portable reconstruction recomputes evaluation from released hourly probabilities, event indicators and forecast-only review plans, then regenerates block-bootstrap contrasts and publication figures. No raw provider MW series, weather grids, price series, fitted models or credentials are included. Software is MIT licensed; author-derived data and author-written supplemental materials are CC BY 4.0 with retained third-party terms and attribution as detailed in DATA_LICENSES.md. This is delayed historical replay, not independently validated live operational availability. The existing v1.0.0 code/data archive is identified by DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23100589. Supplemental materials subsequently added under supplemental_materials/ on GitHub are not represented as part of that earlier deposit. This hosting update does not create a new release, version or DOI.
